content: nixpkgs drawterm (pkgs/by-name/dr/drawterm/package.nix, VERIFIED raw source): builds the 9front fork via fetchFrom9Front rev 3aa7ce0c084089def7e721d7eb8ab091ab95318e, version 0-unstable-2026-10-12, maintainer moody (9front dev), MIT, platforms linux+darwin incl aarch64-darwin/aarch64-linux. darwin: CONF=osx-cocoa CC=clang with llvmPackages.lld, installs gui-cocoa/drawterm.app + bin/drawterm symlink (native Cocoa, no X11/XQuartz needed). linux default: CONF=unix with libx11+libxt, binary wrapped in pulseaudio padsp. linux wayland variant drawterm-wayland (withWayland=true): CONF=linux + pipewire/wayland/wayland-protocols/libxkbcommon/libdecor. Harvey flake can expose pkgs.drawterm (+pkgs.drawterm-wayland) directly as nix run .#drawterm.
